enterpriseId  = value["entID"]
	siteId        = value["sitID"]
	areaId        = value["areID"]
	lineId        = value["linID"]
	workstationId = value["wksID"]
	db            = value["db"]
	
	# WHERE simple (agrega solo lo que venga)
	where = "WHERE 1=1"
	if workstationId is not None:
	    where += " AND ws.ID = {}".format(workstationId)
	if enterpriseId is not None:
	    where += " AND entN.ID = {}".format(enterpriseId)
	if siteId is not None:
	    where += " AND siteN.ID = {}".format(siteId)
	if areaId is not None:
	    where += " AND areaN.ID = {}".format(areaId)
	if lineId is not None:
	    where += " AND lineN.ID = {}".format(lineId)
	
	query = """
	SELECT 
	    ws.ID         AS WorkstationID,
	    wsn.ID        AS WorkstationNodeID,   -- ✅ lo traemos del join con workstationnode
	    n.ID          AS NodeID,
	    p.ID          AS PapoID,
	    p.Description AS PapoName,
	    p.Reference   AS Reference,
	    lastRH.[User]      AS [User],
	    lastRH.[Timestamp] AS [Timestamp],
	    lastRH.[Status]    AS [Status],
	    lastRH.Action      AS Action,
	    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, lastRH.[Timestamp], GETDATE()) AS MinutesSince
	FROM workstation ws
	INNER JOIN workstationnode wsn ON wsn.WorkstationID = ws.ID
	INNER JOIN node n              ON n.ID = wsn.NodeID
	
	-- Mapeo jerárquico usando Type (sin Topic):
	LEFT JOIN node lineN ON 
	    lineN.Type = 'LINE'
	    AND lineN.ID = CASE 
	        WHEN n.Type = 'LINE' THEN n.ID 
	        WHEN n.Type = 'CELL' THEN n.ParentNodeID 
	        ELSE NULL 
	    END
	
	LEFT JOIN node areaN ON 
	    areaN.Type = 'AREA'
	    AND areaN.ID = CASE 
	        WHEN lineN.ID IS NOT NULL THEN lineN.ParentNodeID 
	        ELSE NULL 
	    END
	
	LEFT JOIN node siteN ON 
	    siteN.Type = 'SITE'
	    AND siteN.ID = CASE 
	        WHEN areaN.ID IS NOT NULL THEN areaN.ParentNodeID 
	        ELSE NULL 
	    END
	
	LEFT JOIN node entN ON 
	    entN.Type = 'ENTERPRISE'
	    AND entN.ID = CASE 
	        WHEN siteN.ID IS NOT NULL THEN siteN.ParentNodeID 
	        ELSE NULL 
	    END
	
	INNER JOIN papo p ON p.NodeID = n.ID
	
	-- último registro por Papo/WorkstationNode (para MinutesSince)
	OUTER APPLY (
	    SELECT TOP (1)
	        rh.[User],
	        rh.[Timestamp],
	        rh.[Status],
	        rt.[Description] AS Action
	    FROM registerhistory rh
	    INNER JOIN registertype rt ON rt.ID = rh.RegisterTypeID
	    WHERE rh.WorkstationNodeID = wsn.ID
	      AND rh.PapoID            = p.ID
	    ORDER BY rh.[Timestamp] DESC
	) AS lastRH
	
	{where}
	ORDER BY p.ID;
	""".format(where=where)
	
	ds = system.db.runQuery(query, db)
	
	rows = []
	if ds:
	    for i in range(ds.getRowCount()):
	        ts = ds.getValueAt(i, "Timestamp")
	        ts_str = system.date.format(ts, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") if ts is not None else None
	        rows.append({
	            "workstationID":     ds.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationID"),
	            "workstationnodeID": ds.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationNodeID"),  # ✅ ahora desde wsn.ID
	            "nodeID":            ds.getValueAt(i, "NodeID"),
	            "papoID":            ds.getValueAt(i, "PapoID"),
	            "name":              ds.getValueAt(i, "PapoName"),
	            "reference":         ds.getValueAt(i, "Reference"),
	            "action":            ds.getValueAt(i, "Action"),
	            "status":            ds.getValueAt(i, "Status"),
	            "user":              ds.getValueAt(i, "User"),
	            "timestamp":         ts_str,
	            "minutesSince":      int(ds.getValueAt(i, "MinutesSince") or 0),
	        })
	
	    # ordenar JSON de más a menos por MinutesSince
	    rows.sort(key=lambda x: x["minutesSince"], reverse=True)
	
	return rows
